main_text.head: OCTAVII MENINI IC. ODA IN ADVLATORES PONTIFICIS ROMANI.
ADVLATORES AD PONTIFICEM.

p.i: Pro te pudoris cuncta frena rupi-mus
Nos nos locamus te supremo vertice
Nos te vocamus alterum Ioucm, tuis
Nec iam veremur astra cœlo dicere
Iam regna cuncta, quæ cadens Sol aspicit
Quod sceptra gestent Imperi, totum hoc tui
Hinc turba honores credula immensos tibi
Quod si quis exstet altiori spiritu

page.notes: The left margin line numbers (5, 10, ... 50) are placed beside the verse lines where they stand; their exact line alignment is approximate. The woodcut initial P is joined to "ater" as "Pater". Doubtful readings: "Cœlumque" and "cœlo" may be printed with a ligature; the ligature is transcribed as œ. Two hyphenation marks: "rupi-mus" as printed. The verse lines are each given as one paragraph because the printed poem shows no clear stanza breaks.
